Comment HAIR for your free hair health check 💇‍♀️

Most of us blame the shampoo when our hair feels dry, thin or brittle. Usually it's the daily habits around it.

Hot showers, rough towel-drying, tight buns and high heat all add up. So does what's on your plate: hair is made of protein, and the NHS lists low iron as one cause of hair loss.

This is the first in a little hair series. What should we cover next: dandruff, greying, an itchy scalp or a receding hairline?

Save this for your next wash day, and send it to the friend who straightens their hair every morning.
